name: claude-dev-toolkit
description: Claude Code plugins for everyday engineering work: idea to merged code, safe git, secret protection, PR reviews, release notes, and hands-on access to private AWS instances.

plugins.name: build-flow
plugins.description: Idea to merged code: gather requirements, plan epics/stories/tasks as GitHub issues, then build them with TDD and parallel subagents.

plugins.name: aws-ssm-tools
plugins.description: Private EC2 instances over AWS SSM: find instances, run commands, read logs with secrets masked, port forwarding, temporary ssh/scp access with auto-expiry.

plugins.name: safe-git
plugins.description: Guards git push run by Claude: blocks force pushes, fetches first and blocks pushes from a branch behind its remote, asks before pushing to main/master.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks prompts that contain a token, and blocks Claude from writing tokens, AWS keys or private keys into files or commands.

plugins.name: pr-review-loop
plugins.description: Work through PR review comments: list unresolved threads, fix or push back on each, reply with the commit, resolve only what was fixed.

plugins.name: release-notes
plugins.description: Release notes from git history: commits between tags grouped by Conventional Commit type, breaking changes first; saves to CHANGELOG.md or a draft GitHub release only on confirmation.
